# CONSULAR SERVICES The consular desk serves Confederation citizens, residents of Confederation-funded establishments and any colonist with business in CCA space. Bring your ID card. Bring patience.
## FOR CITIZENS - [bold]Arrival registration:[/bold] every citizen on this colony should be on the mission roll. In an evacuation, the roll is how we find you. - [bold]Passports and travel papers:[/bold] renewals, replacements for lost or damaged documents and emergency single-voyage papers. - [bold]Detention:[/bold] if you are held by the Marshal, the garrison or a corporate security office, you may ask that the mission be told. We will send someone. - [bold]Next of kin:[/bold] the mission handles notification and the return of remains and effects to Nyame or Earth.
## FOR EVERYONE - [bold]Visas:[/bold] work and transit visas for the Nyame Sector. Skilled trades, medical staff and engineers are processed first. - [bold]Currency exchange:[/bold] colony dollars to CCA dollars at the posted rate. No fee for amounts under 500. - [bold]Trade and investment:[/bold] introductions to Confederation lenders for colony businesses. Ask for the commercial attache. - [bold]Notarised documents:[/bold] contracts, wills and affidavits for use in Confederation courts.
## HOURS AND CONDUCT The desk keeps the colony's shift clock and opens every shift the Ambassador is in residence. Weapons are not permitted inside the mission. Mission grounds are inviolate under interstellar diplomatic law, and this office expects the colony's security forces to respect them.
[color=#E8C27A]In an emergency, come to the mission in person. Do not wait for a reply on the board.[/color]
